title: ERCOT hourly served demand and day-ahead forecast
publisher: U.S. Energy Information Administration / ERCOT
version: Snapshot shipped with the explorEDA forecast example
notes: Hourly served demand and the day-ahead forecast for the ERCOT grid, January and February 2021, in UTC hours. The same file feeds the forecast example.

title: Historical weekly Mauna Loa CO2
publisher: Keeling and Whorf; Scripps / CDIAC; distributed by statsmodels
notes: Weekly carbon dioxide concentration at Mauna Loa, March 1958 to December 2001, from the historical flask-data revision. Missing weeks stay blank.

title: Niño 1+2 monthly sea-surface temperatures
publisher: NOAA Climate Prediction Center, ERSST v3b; distributed by statsmodels
notes: Monthly Niño 1+2 sea-surface temperature, 1950 to 2010.

title: Historical annual sunspot numbers
publisher: NOAA historical solar series; distributed by statsmodels
notes: Annual mean sunspot number, 1700 to 2008, from the historical revision before the 2015 recalibration.

title: Annual Nile flow at Aswan
publisher: Historical Aswan observations; distributed by statsmodels
notes: Annual flow of the Nile at Aswan, 1871 to 1970, in 10⁸ cubic metres.

title: Historical US quarterly macroeconomic panel
publisher: U.S. public statistical sources; curated in statsmodels
notes: U.S. quarterly macroeconomic series, 1959 to 2009, in chained 2005 dollars where real.

title: Grunfeld firm investment panel
publisher: Grunfeld; Kleiber and Zeileis; distributed by statsmodels
notes: Annual investment, market value, and capital stock for 11 U.S. firms, 1935 to 1954, in 1947 dollars.

title: Plant operating conditions and stack loss
publisher: Brownlee historical plant data; distributed by statsmodels
notes: Twenty-one days of operation at an ammonia oxidation plant: airflow, water temperature, acid concentration, and loss.

title: Engel household food expenditure
publisher: Engel historical Belgian household survey; distributed by statsmodels
notes: Income and food expenditure for 235 Belgian working-class households, 1857, in Belgian francs.

title: Selected manufacturing strike durations
publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics; Kennan; distributed by statsmodels
notes: Duration of 62 U.S. manufacturing strikes, 1968 to 1976, with an industrial production index.

title: Danish quarterly money and income data
publisher: Johansen and Juselius; distributed by statsmodels
notes: Quarterly Danish money, income, prices, and two interest rates, 1974 to 1987.

title: Selected historical World Bank fertility rates
publisher: World Bank; UN Population Division and national statistical sources; historical statsmodels snapshot
notes: Total fertility rate for twelve countries, 1960 to 2013, from World Development Indicators. Years without a published value stay blank.

title: Iris flower measurements, corrected variant
publisher: R. A. Fisher / UCI Machine Learning Repository; scikit-learn corrected variant
notes: Four measurements of 150 iris flowers from three species, collected by Edgar Anderson.

title: UCI Wine cultivar-recognition assays
publisher: S. Aeberhard and M. Forina / UCI Machine Learning Repository; scikit-learn distribution
notes: Thirteen chemical assays of 178 Italian wines from three cultivars.

title: Longley historical US employment benchmark
publisher: Longley historical regression benchmark; distributed by statsmodels
notes: Sixteen years of U.S. employment, GNP, and population figures, 1947 to 1962.

title: 2018 World Cup group-stage final scores
publisher: OpenFootball community, football.db
notes: All 48 group-stage matches of the 2018 FIFA World Cup: teams, dates, and final scores.

title: Tate artist-metadata alphabetic prefix
publisher: Tate; October 2014 collection metadata archive
notes: Name, birth year, and death year for the first 60 artists, alphabetically, in the Tate collection's 2014 metadata.

title: January 2013 flights from New York
publisher: Bureau of Transportation Statistics, FAA, and Iowa Environmental Mesonet, via nycflights13
notes: Every flight that left Newark, JFK, or LaGuardia in January 2013 (27,004), with the 16 airlines and hourly weather at each airport. Cancelled flights keep blank departure and arrival times.

title: Beijing multi-site air quality, 2016
publisher: Beijing Municipal Environmental Monitoring Center, via the UCI Machine Learning Repository
notes: Daily means for 12 monitoring stations through 2016. A day needs 20 valid hours of 24 to get a PM2.5 value; otherwise it is blank.

title: World Development Indicators, 2000–2023
publisher: World Bank, with UN Population Division and International Comparison Program figures
notes: Population, GDP per person (PPP, constant 2021 dollars), and life expectancy for 217 economies, 2000 to 2023. Aggregates are excluded; a missing row means no published value.

title: Earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 or more, 2023
publisher: U.S. Geological Survey, ANSS Comprehensive Catalog
notes: Every catalogued earthquake of magnitude 4.5 or more in 2023: 7,643 events with time, place, depth, and magnitude. Depth bands at 70 and 300 km are analyst-defined.

title: Unemployment by industry, 2000–2010
publisher: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey, via vega-datasets
notes: Monthly unemployed count (thousands) and unemployment rate for 14 industries, January 2000 to February 2010.

title: Palmer Archipelago penguins
publisher: Kristen Gorman and Palmer Station LTER, via palmerpenguins
notes: Bill, flipper, and body-mass measurements for 344 penguins of three species on three islands, 2007 to 2009. Eleven birds have no recorded sex.

title: Titanic passengers
publisher: Thomas Cason, from Encyclopedia Titanica; kept by Vanderbilt Biostatistics (titanic3)
license: Public domain data, reused with credit
notes: 1,309 passengers with class, sex, age, port, fare, and fate. Crew are not included; 263 ages are blank.

title: Measles in the United States, 1928–2012
publisher: Project Tycho and the CDC, as published by The Wall Street Journal
license: Project Tycho figures, CC BY; CDC statistics
notes: Reported measles cases per 100,000 people for 50 states and DC, 1928 to 2012. Years the publisher marked not available stay blank.

title: Big-tech opening prices, 2010–2023
publisher: Yahoo Finance via Kaggle, packaged by TidyTuesday (2023-02-07)
license: TidyTuesday repository CC0; prices carry no separate license
notes: Opening share prices for 14 large technology companies, every fifth trading day from January 2010 to January 2023, plus each company's first and last day.

title: Presidential vote by state, 1976–2016
publisher: MIT Election Data and Science Lab
notes: Democratic and Republican shares of all votes cast in 51 jurisdictions for 11 elections. Margin is Democratic minus Republican share, in points.

title: Covid-19 case rates by state, weekly
publisher: The New York Times
license: CC BY-NC 4.0, with credit to The New York Times
notes: Seven-day average new cases per 100,000 people, sampled every seventh day from March 2020 to March 2023. One table holds California, Florida, New York, Texas, Vermont, Washington, and the United States as code US; the other holds all 50 states and D.C. with each state’s row and column on an 8 × 11 tile grid.
